raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Split out of #42844 to land the registry separately from the tml-renderers integration.

- Introduce a chat-encoding adapter registry: `ChatEncodingAdapter` / `ChatEncodingOutputAdapter` protocols, a frozen `ChatEncodingAdapterContext`, and a `{spec: {backend: builder}}` registry (`chat_encoding_adapters.py`) used by `serving_chat` and `serving_responses`. Handlers build one adapter per chat encoding spec at construction; unregistered specs fall through to the existing branches.
- Move the inline `chat_encoding_spec == "inkling"` prompt-encoding branch into a legacy `InklingChatEncodingAdapter`. Its `output` is `None`, so output parsing stays with the registered text parsers exactly as before.
- The context carries what current and upcoming adapters need: tokenizer, reasoning/tool-call parser selection, chat output hooks, `hf_config`, `model_path`, `revision`, and a `backend` selector (`"builtin"` by default; an unregistered backend fails at startup with the available list).

## Behavior: zero change

The same 10 unit-test files run on main and on this branch produce identical outcomes for all 825 test ids (the only 12 failures are a pre-existing environment issue in `test_function_call_parser.py::structural_tag`, identical on both sides). Dispatch seams verified path by path: encode, boot-time effort default (same failure mode on a bad env value), media-collection set, stream/non-stream fall-through, Responses item ordering, non-registered specs building no context and making no `get_model()` call, and `skip_tokenizer_init` behavior.

One test-fixture adjustment: three `InklingReasoningEffortTest` fixtures construct the handler with `object.__new__` and bypass `__init__`, so they now inject the adapter directly; assertions unchanged.

## For the next tenants

- A follow-up PR swaps the legacy Inkling adapter's internals to delegate rendering/parsing to `tml-renderers` (the #42844 integration, rebased onto this base).
- A second encoding backend family can register builders under `backend="recipe"` without touching the serving layer. When a producer for that opt-in lands, backend validation must precede the unregistered-spec early return, and checkpoint file resolution should follow the explicit `model_path`/`revision` contract.
- Offline encoding (`encode_simple_chat`) does not go through the registry.

## Test plan

- [x] Identical unit-test outcomes vs main (825 test ids across 10 files, incl. `test_serving_chat.py`, `test_serving_responses.py`, `test_inkling_renderer.py`, anthropic serving, function-call parsers)
- [x] `pre-commit` clean on all changed files

+"""Unregistered chat encoding specs retain the existing serving branches;
+concrete adapters load only when selected."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Callable, Literal, Optional, Protocol
+
+import msgspec
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest, ToolCall
+    from sglang.srt.function_call.core_types import ToolCallItem
+
+EncodingBackend = Literal["builtin", "recipe"]
+
+
+class ChatOutputHooks(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Chat-handler policies an output adapter needs, bound to one handler."""
+
+    tool_call_parsing_active: Callable[[ChatCompletionRequest], bool]
+    history_tool_calls_count: Callable[[ChatCompletionRequest], int]
+    tool_call_id: Callable[[ToolCallItem, int], str]
+
+
+class ResponsesOutputStream(Protocol):
+    def step(
+        self, chunk: dict[str, Any], finish_reason: Optional[dict[str, Any]]
+    ) -> tuple[str, str, list[ToolCallItem]]: ...
+
+
+class ChatEncodingOutputAdapter(Protocol):
+    def parse_chat_response(
+        self,
+        *,
+        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+        output_ids: list[int],
+        finish_reason: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> tuple[Optional[str], str, Optional[list[ToolCall]], dict[str, Any]]: ...
+
+    def stream_chat_chunks(
+        self,
+        *,
+        content: dict[str, Any],
+        index: int,
+        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+        created: int,
+        parser_dict: dict[int, Any],
+        has_tool_calls: dict[int, bool],
+        choice_logprobs: Optional[dict],
+        finish_reason_type: Optional[str],
+        usage: Optional[dict[str, Any]],
+    ) -> list[str]: ...
+
+    def parse_responses_output(
+        self,
+        *,
+        output_ids: list[int],
+        finish_reason: Optional[dict[str, Any]],
+        separate_reasoning: bool,
+        parse_tool_calls: bool,
+    ) -> tuple[str, str, list[ToolCallItem]]: ...
+
+    def new_responses_stream(
+        self, *, separate_reasoning: bool, parse_tool_calls: bool
+    ) -> ResponsesOutputStream: ...
+
+
+class ChatEncodingAdapter(Protocol):
+    collects_openai_media: bool
+    """Whether media still has to be collected from the OpenAI messages after
+    ``encode_messages`` returns prompt ids."""
+
+    @property
+    def output(self) -> Optional[ChatEncodingOutputAdapter]:
+        """None when the configured parsers leave output to the text parsers."""
+        ...
+
+    def encode_messages(
+        self,
+        *,
+        messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+        tools: Optional[list[dict]],
+    ) -> list[int]: ...
+
+
+class ChatEncodingAdapterContext(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Everything a builder may read; a builder takes only what its encoding needs.
+
+    Consumers:
+      tokenizer: prompt encoding (Inkling).
+      reasoning_parser, tool_call_parser, chat_hooks: adapter-owned output parsing.
+      hf_config: config-dependent encoding (DeepSeek V4.1 image_token_id).
+      model_path, revision: checkpoint files (DeepSeek tokenizer.json and the
+        encoder file for effort-profile detection).
+      backend: selects the builder; "recipe" is an explicit opt-in.
+    """
+
+    chat_encoding_spec: str
+    tokenizer: Any
+    reasoning_parser: Optional[str]
+    tool_call_parser: Optional[str]
+    chat_hooks: ChatOutputHooks
+    hf_config: Any
+    model_path: str
+    revision: Optional[str]
+    backend: EncodingBackend = "builtin"
+
+    def require(self, field: str) -> Any:
+        value = getattr(self, field)
+        if value is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"chat encoding spec {self.chat_encoding_spec!r} ({self.backend} backend) "
+                f"requires {field}, which this server does not provide"
+            )
+        return value
+
+
+def _build_inkling(ctx: ChatEncodingAdapterContext) -> ChatEncodingAdapter:
+    from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_inkling import InklingChatEncodingAdapter
+
+    return InklingChatEncodingAdapter(tokenizer=ctx.tokenizer)
+
+
+_BUILDERS: dict[
+    str,
+    dict[EncodingBackend, Callable[[ChatEncodingAdapterContext], ChatEncodingAdapter]],
+] = {
+    "inkling": {"builtin": _build_inkling},
+}
+
+
+def has_chat_encoding_adapter(chat_encoding_spec: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+    return chat_encoding_spec in _BUILDERS
+
+
+def build_chat_encoding_adapter(
+    ctx: ChatEncodingAdapterContext,
+) -> Optional[ChatEncodingAdapter]:
+    builders = _BUILDERS.get(ctx.chat_encoding_spec, {})
+    builder = builders.get(ctx.backend)
+    if builder is not None:
+        return builder(ctx)
+    if ctx.backend != "builtin":
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"chat encoding spec {ctx.chat_encoding_spec!r} has no {ctx.backend} backend; "
+            f"available: {sorted(builders) or ['builtin']}"
+        )
+    return None

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Optional
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat import OpenAIServingChat
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest
+
+
+class InklingChatEncodingAdapter:
+    """Inkling prompt encoding through ``inkling_renderer``; output stays with
+    the registered ``inkling`` reasoning and tool-call parsers."""
+
+    collects_openai_media = True
+    output = None
+
+    def __init__(self, *, tokenizer: Any):
+        self._tokenizer = tokenizer
+        # Resolved at boot: a misconfigured env default fails startup, not requests.
+        self._default_reasoning_effort = (
+            OpenAIServingChat._get_inkling_default_reasoning_effort()
+        )
+
+    def encode_messages(
+        self,
+        *,
+        messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+        tools: Optional[list[dict]],
+    ) -> list[int]:
+        from sglang.srt.parser.inkling_renderer import render_inkling_messages
+        from sglang.srt.parser.inkling_tokenizer import (
+            CONTENT_TEXT,
+            MESSAGE_MODEL,
+            InklingTokenizer,
+        )
+
+        # Framing tokens + ONE placeholder per media (encoding/expansion happens later
+        # in InklingMultimodalProcessor). The server's tokenizer is the base tiktoken
+        # backend; wrap it so encode_special supplies the framing-token overlay.
+        inkling_tokenizer = InklingTokenizer(tokenizer=self._tokenizer)
+        reasoning_effort = OpenAIServingChat._parse_inkling_reasoning_effort(
+            request.reasoning_effort
+        )
+        if reasoning_effort is None:
+            reasoning_effort = self._default_reasoning_effort
+        assistant_prefix = OpenAIServingChat._pop_inkling_assistant_prefix(
+            messages, request
+        )
+        prompt_ids = render_inkling_messages(
+            messages,
+            inkling_tokenizer,
+            add_generation_prompt=False,
+            tools=tools,
+            reasoning_effort=reasoning_effort,
+        )
+        if assistant_prefix is not None:
+            # Continue the final assistant message inside an OPEN model text
+            # block: header + payload, no <|end_message|> and no
+            # <|content_model_end_sampling|>, so the model resumes the turn.
+            prompt_ids += [
+                inkling_tokenizer.encode_special(MESSAGE_MODEL),
+                inkling_tokenizer.encode_special(CONTENT_TEXT),
+                *inkling_tokenizer.encode_text(assistant_prefix),
+            ]
+        return prompt_ids
